title: feat(app-shell): offer Disable / Enable on a suite's module rows from the served disableable verdict
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbELzM8mf3sjACy6nzVrqj1y)_

Fixes #28118

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：软件包详情面板的「禁用 / 启用」按钮改为只看服务端下发的 `disableable` 判定（不再看 `writable`）。套件里 `type: 'module'` 的模块包（对创作只读、但服务端允许禁用）现在会出现「禁用」，走原有确认对话框；禁用后出现「启用」。编辑、发布、还原、复制、收编、删除仍然只看 `writable`，在模块行上继续隐藏。模块行的只读提示改为说明「不能编辑或删除，但可以禁用并重新启用」（新增两个 studio 文案，en / zh）。市场手册补充了这个按钮和 `disableable` 键。
- **为什么改**：#28117 让管理员可以禁用已安装应用的模块，#28318 在 `GET /packages` 上下发了 `disableable`。裁决「最小做法」：不加新页面，就在现有的软件包页给开关。
- **风险与回滚**：按钮只在服务端说 `disableable: true` 时出现，没有新的写入路径，也没有新权限（仍是 `manage_metadata`）。可写包的服务端判定同样是 `disableable: true`，所以它们的「禁用」不变。缺少该键的行不会出现「禁用」（失败即关闭）。落地顺序受 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2383 约束：在它落地前本 PR 保持草稿，不对客户可见。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`（`disableable` 读取、按钮门槛、只读提示的分支）、`PackagesPage.moduleDisable-28118.test.tsx`（新测试）、`content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`（手册两处）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.moduleDisable-28118.test.tsx`，预期 10 个用例全绿：模块行有「禁用」且需确认、其余写操作隐藏、无判定的只读行没有「禁用」、已禁用的模块行有「启用」、Installed Apps 视图里模块是单独一行。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位在 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2383 落地后落地。

## What changes

- **Disable reads the served verdict.** `PackageDetailSheet` gates its Disable / Enable button on the row's `disableable` (the disable door's own verdict, `package-api-assembled.zod.ts` `SERVED_ROW_VERDICTS`, served by `GET /api/v1/packages` and `GET /api/v1/packages/:id`), not on `writable`. It is read the way the sheet reads `writable`: anything but `true` offers no Disable. ⛔ Nothing is re-derived from `manifest.type`, `scope` or `writable`. Enable is still offered on any disabled package, as before (the enable door has no writability gate).
- **Every other write stays on `writable`.** Edit, Publish, Revert, Duplicate, Adopt loose items and Delete are unchanged, so a module row (`writable: false`, `disableable: true`) offers only Disable / Enable beside the reads.
- **The read-only note.** A read-only row that is disableable no longer says it "cannot be edited, disabled or deleted": two studio keys, `engine.packages.detail.readOnlyDisableable` and `engine.packages.detail.codeReadOnlyDisableable` (en, zh), say it cannot be edited or deleted but can be disabled and enabled again. The confirm dialog's consequence sentence (`disableDescription`) already reads right for a module and is unchanged.
- **Type.** `InstalledPackageRow` gains `disableable?: InstalledPackageAtEitherStage['disableable']`, taken from the spec's served row. It is optional on the row type so that a row without the key types and renders as "not disableable".
- **Docs (doc rider 6540426908).** `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`: step 7 says each package of a suite is its own row in Installed Apps and the sheet offers Disable where the runtime allows it; "Disabling a module" names the Console path and the `disableable` key.

Where module rows appear, measured before coding (reported on the card): install-local registers every package of the artifact with `source: 'marketplace'`, so a marketplace suite's modules are their own rows in **Setup → Installed Apps** (`?source=marketplace`). A suite booted from code has `source: 'code'`; its modules are on the unfiltered **Setup → Packages** page, with the same button.

## Tests

- New `PackagesPage.moduleDisable-28118.test.tsx` (10 cases, real `PackageDetailSheet` and real `PackagesPage`):
  - (1) a module row with `disableable: true` shows Disable; it opens the confirm with the consequence copy, sends nothing until confirmed, then sends the one `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id/disable`;
  - (2) every other write action is hidden on it; its read-only note is the disableable one, scope-less and project-scoped;
  - (3) `disableable: false` and a row with no key offer no Disable and keep the plain read-only note;
  - (4) a disabled module row shows Enable, which runs at once with no dialog;
  - (5) a non-module row served `disableable: true` offers Disable: the verdict decides, not `manifest.type`;
  - the Installed Apps view lists a marketplace module as its own row and its sheet offers Disable; control: the suite's app row (`disableable: false`) offers none.
- Existing fixtures in `readOnlyActions-13157`, `readOnlyReasonAndDisableConfirm-27521`, `adoptLooseItems-13339` and `confirmFlows-11784` now carry `disableable` as the server serves it for a non-module package (equal to `writable`).
- Ablation, once, on commit `2d45950f`: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the gate back to `writable || !enabled` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `93d7556c` → `7ebf253c`). The new file went red, 3 failed / 7 passed: (1), (5) and the Installed Apps case. Restored blob `93d7556c` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Case (4) and the controls stay green both ways, as expected: Enable does not change.

## Acceptance notes

- `disableable` is optional on the row type and the list does not refuse a row without it, unlike `source` and `writable`. A missing key fails closed (no Disable, the door's own answer) instead of refusing the whole list. Making it a refused key would touch every page-level fixture; noted, not done.
- The landing waits on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2383 (the card's `Blocked-by:`), per the ordering addendum 6523692915. The PR stays draft until then.
- A code-booted suite's modules are not in Installed Apps (they are `source: 'code'`); that is the existing Source filter's meaning and is unchanged here.

The derived-gate sweep above is from `2d45950f`, before the merge; the merge adds no file to this diff.
- Dogfood battery: n/a, no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
- NOT MEASURED: a live Console against a marketplace-installed suite. The measurement is from source and the landed server tests (`packages-disable-app-module.test.ts` pins the module row's `source` per install path; `packages-disableable-verdict.test.ts` pins the served verdict).
